desc:
PrestaShop store management is the routine work that keeps a shop accurate and healthy. Ecom Swift LLC takes a first round of your back office jobs, from product edits to module updates, and reports what changed and what needs your decision.

## What does PrestaShop store management cover?

PrestaShop store management means the everyday tasks inside the back office that keep a shop current. That includes editing products, updating stock and prices, uploading new items, checking recent orders, reviewing carrier settings, applying module updates and tidying settings that have grown messy.

This service is a starter sprint, a first round of that work. It is not an open-ended contract. Ongoing monthly help can be quoted later, once you know how much support you really need.

## What happens when upkeep is ignored

A shop that nobody tends slowly goes wrong. Prices fall out of date, products stay live after they sell out, and descriptions contain old details. Modules fall behind their updates, which can leave known faults in place. Cart rules and coupons from old campaigns stay active longer than intended, and orders stuck in an odd status go unnoticed.

None of this is dramatic on its own. But customers meet these small errors as wrong prices, broken discounts and slow replies, and each one weakens trust in the shop.

## How steady upkeep improves your results

Steady upkeep protects the sale you already earned. When stock and prices are right, customers receive what they ordered at the price they saw. When modules are updated and tested, the shop is less likely to break at a bad moment. When orders are reviewed, a stuck payment or a missing carrier rule is found early.

It also frees your time. Product edits and sheet uploads are repetitive, and handing them off gives you room for buying, marketing and customers. The benefit is accuracy and time, not a promise of higher sales.

## What good store upkeep includes

- Product edits for titles, prices, descriptions, categories and visibility.
- Stock and price updates imported from your supplier or spreadsheet.
- New products uploaded with images, combinations and correct categories.
- A review of recent orders for odd statuses, failed payments and missing tracking.
- Module updates applied one at a time, with a check after each.
- A look at cart rules and coupons for expired or overlapping offers.
- Category and search tidying, so shoppers find items quickly.
- A check of carrier and tax rules against what you actually ship.
- A short report of what was done and what needs a decision.
- A simple monthly checklist you can follow yourself.

## How we run your first round

We work in your own PrestaShop back office through a staff or developer user, and we never need your password. Before changing anything we take note of the current state and, for module updates, confirm you have a recent backup.

You send a sheet or a list of what you want done. We apply the edits, upload new products, update modules and review the orders. The Basic package covers a batch of product edits, a stock and price update and an order review. Standard adds more edits, new product uploads, tested module updates and a cart rule check. Premium adds a larger clean up, category and search tidying, a carrier and tax review and a monthly checklist.

We do not issue refunds or answer customer emails as part of this service. Those decisions stay with you.

## What to do and what to avoid

**Do:**
- Prepare a clear spreadsheet with product codes, prices and stock numbers.
- Keep a recent backup before any update.
- Mark which edits are urgent and which can wait.
- Tell us about seasonal sales or coming campaigns.
- Read the report and answer the questions it raises.

**Avoid:**
- Sending several versions of a sheet with conflicting figures.
- Updating modules and the theme on the same day.
- Leaving old discount codes active after a campaign ends.
- Deleting products that have order history.
- Expecting this one round to replace ongoing support.

## Who this is for

This service suits busy owners who have fallen behind on catalog edits and want to catch up. It suits shops after a supplier price change that touches many products. It also suits new owners who took over a PrestaShop store and want a cleaner starting point before deciding on regular help.

## How to get started

Send us your list of tasks and the files that go with them, such as a product sheet or supplier file. Add us as a staff or developer user in the back office. We reply with a checklist, complete the round and send the summary report with the items needing your choice.
